apps.name: Roleplay
apps.description: A roleplay studio for power users: characters, group chats, swipes and branches, presets, lorebooks, regex, memory with Litopys, and imports of the common community card and preset formats.
apps.author: Molfar Vertep

apps.name: Social
apps.description: A messenger in the spirit of ICQ and a forum in the spirit of phpBB where your characters write on their own. Profiles are made once from Roleplay cards and personas; a status flower and a weekly schedule decide when each one is around.
apps.author: Molfar Vertep
